auth_bridge_start.title: Set up Nest Protect
auth_bridge_start.description:
Nest Protect is not available through Google's official SDM API. This setup uses an Auth Bridge so you can sign in normally without browser developer tools.

Home Assistant OS/Supervised: use the Auth Bridge add-on.

Home Assistant Container/Core: use the standalone Docker Auth Bridge.

Continue to start a one-time authentication session.

auth_bridge_wait.title: Waiting for Nest Protect sign-in
auth_bridge_wait.description:
The Auth Bridge is ready. Click the launch link below to start the login session:

[{auth_bridge_launch_url}]({auth_bridge_launch_url})

HA OS/Supervised: if the launch link does not open automatically, open the add-on from the sidebar and click Start Login there.

Container/Core: use the standalone Auth Bridge web UI you started with Docker.

If this page does not auto-refresh after login, click Submit.

**Troubleshooting/developer only:** Ingress URL handling can vary; if needed, open the bridge UI manually and reuse the launch URL query string. Enable the manual fallback option below only for troubleshooting.

wizard_login.title: Nest Protect instellen
wizard_login.description:
Nest Protect is not exposed through the official Google Nest SDM API, even when your alarms appear in the Google Home app. This integration therefore uses the Nest web authentication flow.

Paste an authentication helper output block into the first field. The helper must capture the real issueToken request URL and Cookie request header locally; Home Assistant itself cannot read Google request headers from your browser.

The separate Issue Token URL and Cookie header fields are for legacy or emergency fallback use only.

data_description.wizard_output: Paste the complete block printed by a Nest Protect authentication helper.
data_description.issue_token: Fallback only: full URL beginning with https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/iframerpc.
data_description.cookies: Fallback only: full Cookie request header captured by the wizard or manual troubleshooting.

error.network_timeout: The Google/Nest request timed out. Try again after checking your network connection.
error.authentication_rejected: Google/Nest rejected these credentials. Run the wizard again and do not log out of home.nest.com afterward.
error.invalid_issue_token: Invalid Issue Token URL. Paste the full issueToken request URL, including all query parameters.
error.incomplete_cookie_header: Cookie header looks incomplete. Copy the full Cookie header from the oauth2/iframe Network request.
error.no_devices_found: Authentication succeeded, but no Nest Protect devices were found on this account.
error.unexpected_response: Nest returned an unexpected response. Try again or open an issue with redacted diagnostics.
